bracket.notAllowed: Brackets are available only on an order that opens or increases a position.
warnings.MARKET_CLOSED: The market is closed, so the order rests until it opens.
warnings.IMMEDIATE_FILL: This order fills at once at the current price.
warnings.OPENS_SHORT: This order opens a short position.

errors.generic: The order could not be placed. Try again.
